title: AI, Chat Layout by @julesforrest: Reimagining a quiz-style onboarding flow for Al Dente using voice inst
notes:
Reimagining a quiz-style onboarding flow for Al Dente using voice instead of clickable inputs. This exploration was originally inspired by password validation patterns, where requirements get checked off as they're met by the string you're typing in.

Designer: @julesforrest. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
